story.fullStory:
Robert Palmer's "Addicted To Love" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Addicted to Love" is a song by the English rock singer Robert Palmer released in 1986.

It is the third song on Palmer's eighth studio album Riptide (1985) and was released as its third single.

The single version is a shorter edit of the full-length album version.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.
